templates.titleEn: Determine oxidation numbers and identify redox processes
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Oxidationszahlen für Atome in anorganischen und organischen Teilchen herleiten und daran Redoxvorgänge erkennen.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can derive oxidation numbers for atoms in inorganic and organic species and use their changes to identify redox processes.

currentBody.title: Einfache Redoxgleichungen mit Oxidationszahlen erstellen
currentBody.titleEn: Create simple redox equations using oxidation numbers
currentBody.description: Die lernende Person kann Oxidationszahlen nutzen, einfache Redoxteilgleichungen in wässrigen Lösungen formulieren und Redoxgleichungen fachlich korrekt erstellen.
currentBody.descriptionEn: The learner can use oxidation numbers, formulate simple redox half-equations, and write redox equations correctly.

templates.bindingHold: Separate 11bea prerequisite remains scientifically open; existing goal gets targeted current source/D/A/M/V review and revised context binding before reuse. No ID adopted, no blanket deletion of 11bea.

rows.widthPreservation: All inorganic/organic identification and equation balancing preserved in separate explicit atoms.

templates.titleEn: Prepare solutions of defined amount concentration
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus Stoffmenge und Lösungsvolumen die Stoffmengenkonzentration einer sauren oder basischen Lösung bestimmen, benötigte Stoffmengen berechnen und eine Lösung definierter Konzentration fachgerecht herstellen.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can determine amount concentration from amount of substance and solution volume for an acidic or basic solution, calculate the required amounts and correctly prepare a solution of defined concentration.

templates.titleDe: pH starker Säuren und Basen bestimmen und prüfen
templates.titleEn: Determine and check pH of strong acids and bases
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann den pH-Wert hinreichend verdünnter wässriger Lösungen starker Säuren und Basen aus ihrer Stoffmengenkonzentration unter begründeten Modellannahmen bestimmen und gemessene pH-Werte auf Plausibilität prüfen.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can determine the pH of sufficiently dilute aqueous solutions of strong acids and bases from their amount concentration using justified model assumptions and check measured pH values for plausibility.

requiredContexts.preparation: Known target amount concentration and solution volume; identity, purity, molar mass or stock concentration as needed; learner calculation and own appropriate preparation remain required, not supplied-model-only replacement. Resolve existing amount/concentration prerequisites, mass measurement and n=m/M explicitly.
requiredContexts.pH: Specified solute and stoichiometry, temperature and dilute aqueous approximation; complete protolysis/dissociation and neglect of water autoprotolysis must be justified for the selected concentration. For pH+pOH=14 explicitly 25 °C ideal dilute-water convention; changed temperature uses supplied pKw. No weak-acid/pKs or arbitrary extreme dilution introduced.

rows.reverseRequiresRoutingHold: 026 titration requires the concentration/preparation atom, not automatically the whole pH companion. 1c Brønsted must be evaluated for a suitable concept-level prerequisite, not automatically moved to strong-pH competence. Preserve all other current consumers until per-edge need checked.

templates.titleEn: Explain the direction of proton transfers
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die bevorzugte Richtung einer Protonenübertragung im betrachteten Medium mit korrespondierenden Säure-Base-Paaren und gegebenen relativen Säure- und Basenstärken begründen.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can justify the preferred direction of a proton transfer in the considered medium using conjugate acid-base pairs and supplied relative acid and base strengths.

templates.titleEn: Provide qualitative evidence for hydronium and hydroxide ions
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus geeigneten Indikatorbefunden den sauren oder basischen Charakter einer wässrigen Probe begründen und diesen im Teilchenmodell auf einen Überschuss von Oxonium- oder Hydroxidionen beziehen.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can justify the acidic or basic character of an aqueous sample from suitable indicator observations and relate it in the particle model to an excess of hydronium or hydroxide ions.

templates.titleEn: Reflect on the scope of acid-base models
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Aussagen des Arrhenius- und des Brønsted-Konzepts an geeigneten Säure-Base-Beispielen vergleichen und begründen, welche Teilchen- und Lösungsaussagen das jeweilige Modell erlaubt.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can compare the Arrhenius and Brønsted concepts using suitable acid-base examples and justify which statements about species and solutions each model supports.

rows.reuseLimits: d2 carries indicator evidence but not automatically relative-ion particle inference. fd309 currently says presence of H3O+/OH−; both species occur in aqueous solutions, so exact reuse needs bounded excess/relative-concentration wording review outside this packet before adoption. 481 is the distinct quantitative pK/MWG target, not a substitute for all generic reflection.
rows.sourceStageHold: HE G9 10.3 pair/ampholyte clauses do not license a new whole direction target there. HB original Q S23 licenses strengths and equilibrium jointly with other goals; extraction pK wording is derived. General model reflection has no separately established exact primary operator here. No new ID until source/stage and reuse review settle all three original performances.

exactPrimaryOperatorFoundOutsideContentC.section: C10 Lernbereich1 process competence and contents: properties, explanatory power, limits/extensions of models
exactPrimaryOperatorFoundOutsideContentC.boundary: Generic modelling reflection is genuinely normative; acid/base specialization is an authored application, not a literal acid/base content operator. Requires exact current modelling-goal reuse review or a new independently reviewed atom.
